title: ProfileAdoptionAndOverridesSections
description: SPI v2 type definitions for the optional top-level `adoption` and `overrides` sections of a profile descriptor (skill-family.profile-descriptor). The adoption declaration is the lightweight adoption proof that replaces the deprecated adoption-lock concept (remediation handoff D-8); overrides carry self-tightening rule declarations that reuse the original rule ids with project-level numeric values (handoff D-6). profiles/spi/index.mjs composes these $defs onto the contracts profile-descriptor schema; the contracts package itself is not modified here.

version.description: Exact pinned version of this Foundation package.

path.description: Relative POSIX path of the pinned artifact inside the profile write set; verifyProfile reads it through the containment layer and compares its real sha256 against the declared digest (GK-4 real-file discipline).

sha256.description: Declared sha256 hex digest of the pinned artifact bytes.

adoption.description: Foundation adoption declaration (minimal D-8 field set). Presence is optional; when present every field is mandatory and mechanically verified by verifyProfile.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier of the adopted Foundation profile.

version.description: Integer version of the adopted Foundation profile.

stability.description: Stability class of the adopted Foundation profile at adoption time.

foundation_pin.description: Pin of all three Foundation packages (contracts, harness-node, engineering-kit) with exact versions and artifact sha256 digests.

algorithm.description: Digest algorithm; sha256 is the only admitted value.

adopted_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time at which the adoption took place.

overrides.description: Self-tightening override declarations (handoff D-6): each entry reuses an existing rule id with a project-level numeric value. Overrides may only tighten the baseline, never relax it; every entry is machine-checked by verifyProfile against the frozen rule baseline catalog (profiles/spi/rule-baseline-catalog.json).

ruleId.description: Canonical rule id being tightened (no new rule id is minted; the original id is reused).

parameter.description: Named numeric parameter of the rule, as registered in the rule baseline catalog.

value.description: Project-level override value; must strictly tighten the catalog baseline in the parameter's declared direction.

note.description: Optional human rationale; not consumed mechanically.
